scientific_integrity: The general proof is algebraic and combinatorial; finite prime-field checks are independent supporting tests, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Only one-permutation, all weights nonzero; full spectrum over uniformly varying multiplication inputs, not an algebra isomorphism classification. An earlier equivalent distribution under weighted monomial matrices may exist; independent priority review remains necessary.
title: The complete multiplication-operator similarity census of finite-field permutation evolution algebras
